content.title: Patrice Evra tells Barcelona fans to stop dreaming of remontada and face reality
content.text: Published 2026.04.14. 14:21"Now it's time to face reality."Patrice Evra (45) unleashed scathing remarks toward FC Barcelona. He directly told Barcelona fans dreaming of the 2017 "remontada," "Start by removing those photos."German outlet Sport1 reported on the 14th (Korea time) that "Patrice Evra strongly criticized Barcelona ahead of the second leg of the Champions League quarterfinal against Atlético Madrid."Barcelona suffered a 0-2 defeat to Atlético Madrid in the first leg. They now need to win the away second leg by at least a two-goal margin. It's not easy.Evra saw no chance. He told Spanish outlet Sport, "Barcelona fans need to wake up and accept reality." He added, "I see photos everywhere with the word 'remontada.' It's time to be humble. Remove those photos."The "remontada" Evra referred to was the miracle of 2017. At that time, Barcelona lost the first leg of the Champions League round of 16 to Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) 0-4. They achieved a miraculous comeback, winning the second leg 6-1.The problem is that today's Barcelona is not the Barcelona of that time.Evra said bluntly, "This is not the Barcelona of 2015. That team no longer exists." He added, "Barcelona always collapsed in big matches. To be honest, they don't have the ability to overturn it this time either."In fact, Barcelona has repeatedly faltered on the European stage in recent years. Whenever they reach the Champions League knockout stage, they have crumbled at decisive moments. This season is no different. They were crushed in the first leg, and compounded by being a player down, they could not mount a proper counterattack.Evra even thought it more likely that a Barcelona player would be sent off again. He said, "I fully trust Diego Simeone and his players."He went on, "They are warriors. They are well prepared, and they are ready to stop Barcelona."Evra also said Barcelona is no longer the king of Europe. They used to be a team that overwhelmed opponents. They are not now. So he asserted that Barcelona would not be dominant even in the Madrid away second leg.Finally, he sharpened his words at Barcelona fans once more. Evra said, "Barcelona fans, be quiet. Europe is a different story. You are no longer kings. I love football. But I love the truth more."[OSEN]※ This article has been translated by AI. Share your feedback here.
